target.statement: Average AUC-PR of AutoEncoder with overlapping inference (s=1) on the 350 evaluation time series of TSB-AD = 0.47
target.table_ref: Table I (AutoEncoder row, AUC-PR Overlap column)

compute.basis: The headline cell is an average over 350 series of a model that was selected via a 108-trial hyperparameter search (3 seeds) and then re-run with 5 seeds; reproducing it faithfully means retraining the AutoEncoder many times across 350 series, which is hours of CPU work even though each individual model is tiny.

blockers: Full 108-trial x 3-seed tuning plus 5-seed evaluation over 350 series is heavy for a CPU-only laptop
Reproducing the exact 0.47 requires the paper's tuning/selection protocol and the TSB-AD 15% tuning split, not just a single training run
Code repo may not ship the exact configs/scripts for the AutoEncoder overlap cell
title: Disjoint or Overlapping? Inference Windowing for Reconstruction-Based Time Series Anomaly Detection
